snapshot.business_summary: Reliance Industries Limited operates across diverse segments including Oil to Chemicals (O2C), which encompasses refining, petrochemicals, fuel retailing, and aviation fuel. The company is also involved in Oil and Gas exploration and production, consumer retail services, and a range of digital services. These segments are deeply integrated, with O2C being the largest contributor to revenue.

trajectory.takeaway: Revenue shows a consistent upward trend over the reported quarters.
EBITDA has also shown a strong increasing trend across the reported quarters.

guidance.verbatim_quote: So, when you look at the first half of FY 2027 performance, it is in our minds tracking annualized EBITDA well over Rs.80,000 Crores and I think this is something, it just tells you how the markets are.
guidance.speaker: Sh V Srikanth, CFO, Reliance Industries Limited

guidance.verbatim_quote: And on new energy, I just wanted to say that it is accelerating and we see the benefit, earnings contribution definitely starting in FY 2028.
guidance.speaker: Sh V Srikanth, CFO, Reliance Industries Limited

bull.argument: Significant expansion and growth in online grocery B2C, up 42% year-on-year, showing early signs of progress.
Expansion of fixed wireless access (FWA) with 15.1 million connections and over 78% market share, expected to ramp up in coming quarters.
Strong crude sourcing flexibility, enabling switches between crude grades from various regions, and premium ethane advantage.
Initial Public Offer (IPO) of Jio Platforms Limited (JPL) raising gross proceeds of 30,188 crore via fresh issue of 27,00,00,000 equity shares.

bear.argument: High inflation is impacting consumer purchasing power and domestic demand.
Currency depreciation is significantly affecting the landed costs of imported products.
Elevated operating expenses driven by crude premiums, surge in freight rates, and increased insurance costs.
